contract.description: Both variants export the same live formatter; only the overbuilt variant carries an unreachable legacy adapter.
required_behaviors: format remains the only public export

overbuilt.content:
function legacy(value: string) { return '<' + value + '>'; }
export function format(value: string) { return '[' + value + ']'; }

minimal.content: export function format(value: string) { return '[' + value + ']'; }
